svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Isometric of a double-layer space frame: a square top grid and a bottom grid offset by half a bay, tied together by diagonals into rows of half-octahedra, all meeting at ball joints, so a light roof can span widely on only four columns. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of
this form; no external drawing reproduced.
